entities.name: Starnheim
entities.description: One of the ten realms of Kaldheim, at the top of the World Tree, source of the plane's light and home of the Valkyries and the honored dead.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: The plane of ten realms that has no sun or moon.

entities.name: Hall of the Valkyries
entities.description: A cavernous longhall woven from the living branches of the World Tree where worthy heroes feast eternally.

entities.name: Valkmir
entities.description: The glassy black lake made from the blood of the first Valkyrie who died during the world's creation, from which all Valkyries were birthed.

entities.name: Prismatic Path
entities.description: A rainbow bridge flowing from a Valkyrie's wings, leading to the Hall of the Valkyries.

entities.name: Yetta Docks
entities.description: Wooden docks around the Hall of the Valkyries where twelve longships wait, one for each of the Skoti.

entities.name: World Tree
entities.description: The great tree whose top holds Starnheim.

entities.name: Valkyries
entities.description: Winged beings of Starnheim who choose the heroes who feast forever in their hall.

entities.name: Skoti
entities.description: The current reigning gods of Kaldheim.

entities.name: Niko Aris
entities.description: A planeswalker who arrived at Starnheim and joined the valkyries in defending it.

entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: A planeswalker who instigated chaos on Kaldheim.

entities.name: Koma
entities.description: The Cosmos serpent that attacked Starnheim.

events.summary: Niko Aris arrives at Starnheim and sees a radiant plane atop black mirror-like waters.
events.quote: When Niko Aris arrived at Starnheim, they saw a mostly radiant plane as if before dawn, atop black mirror-like waters.

events.summary: During the chaos instigated by Tibalt, Koma attacks Starnheim and Niko joins the valkyries in its defense.
events.quote: Starnheim was attacked by the the Cosmos serpent Koma and Niko joined a host of valkyries in defense of the realm.

relations.note: One of the ten realms of the plane.
relations.quote: Starnheim is one of the ten realms of the plane of Kaldheim .

relations.note: The longhall at the heart of Starnheim.
relations.quote: the longhall at the heart of Starnheim is awe-inspiring.

relations.note: Joined the valkyries defending the realm from Koma.
relations.quote: Niko joined a host of valkyries in defense of the realm.
Starnheim was attacked by the the Cosmos serpent Koma
